note: Local metres around each anchor: +x east, +z south (three.js local axes before rotation). Buildings: the OSM footprints (osm = way / relation id, from the OSM API on 2026-11-27) with the height the HK page draws for them (h: OSM height / levels where mapped, otherwise the pipeline's estimate for the building class - NOT verified, often wrong for towers: use the target's h / hs), floors = OSM building:levels, type = the page's class; parts = the page's building:part pieces inside the outline (base / top heights, osm id when matched). roads: the page's own road lines (cls as in FORMATS; bridge = has deck heights; elev = deck height above the ground per vertex). areas: named OSM land-use / amenity polygons clipped to the box. pois: named OSM nodes and the page's POIs. terrain: the page's ground (m) on a grid (rows north to south). ground = terrain height at the anchor.
